name: Future Tech 2027
description: .NET, Microsoft technologies and AI developer conference in Utrecht
note: on-site; English site, some Dutch sessions; ticket prices published when sales open
details:
Future Tech is a community developer conference produced by S&S Media NL, with the theme ".NET, Microsoft Technologies & AI Innovation". The 2027 edition runs 10-11 March 2027 at Jaarbeurs Utrecht.

The site is in English with some Dutch session titles and speaker bios; the talk language is not stated. Ticket types and prices for 2027 are published when sales open; attendee numbers are not stated.
